title: Discover Tracecraft CLI commands without running a workflow

requirements.statement: Users can discover CLI syntax through explicit read-only help.

acceptance.statement: help, --help and -h each exit zero with equivalent JSON containing usage and all implemented command names.
Help with extra arguments is rejected with exit 2; an unknown command remains an error.
Help works from an empty directory and creates no files or project configuration.

sources.reference: bin/tracecraft.mjs currently exposes usage only through input errors; README describes source-checkout invocation.

decisions.summary: Reuse JSON CLI output and one shared implemented-command list; handle help before workflow parsing.

tasks.summary: Add explicit help aliases and integration checks without running workflows.

tests.summary: CLI integration assertions for aliases, invalid arguments and empty-directory read-only behavior.
